summary: All three phases delivered their stated objectives. Phase-01 renamed the Archived terminal status to Completed across six source files, six test files, and 78 archived artifacts with no deviations. Phase-02 renamed the CLI verb, registered the hidden refusal, and regenerated the three derived documents; one unplanned file (src/cli/introspect.ts) was edited to keep a pre-existing usageParity integration test green — the deviation is justified and documented. Phase-03 updated the three shipped skill bundles to the new vocabulary with no deviations. Commit subjects and bodies match their plan templates exactly across all phases.
